correctness.rationale: The Grover coin acts as -I on each local zero-sum amplitude vector. On an edge from shell m to m+1 the two directed amplitude equations are consistent precisely when eigenphase squared equals p_m p_(m+1). Every unsigned-incidence kernel flow on the connected bipartite shell graph therefore embeds injectively into each eigenvalue branch. Connectivity implies incidence rank V-1. Binomial summation gives the aggregate lower bound. Alternating six-cycle flow gives exactly six equal 1/6 position masses. The companion verification code independently computes updates and graph ranks and passed 546 deterministic checks for d=3..9; this is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The originating paper explicitly motivates localization in odd hypercube dimensions via non-fixed eigenvalues. The theorem provides the first fully explicit six-site stationary eigenstate across all odd and even d>=3 in that exact model and calculates orthogonal shell-flow subspace dimensions, occupying asymptotically all modes. This is a structural, physically interpretable answer to an identifiable mathematical gap, not a small numerical increment or relabeling of an example.
